say:2:1321111001:1.text: Excuse me, Sir. Do you have any place you long to be?
say:2:1321111001:1.source_cn: 打扰一下，工匠先生。你有没有非常向往的地方？

say:3:1321111002:1.text: Ha! I wish there were a research facility stocked with all kinds of materials and the most advanced machinery! I'd be holed up inside every day, cranking out amazing creations!
say:3:1321111002:1.source_cn: 哈，要是有一个材料齐全、有各种最先进机械的研究所，我肯...

say:4:1321111003:1.text: Why? Is Cedartown ready to build us a research facility?
say:4:1321111003:1.source_cn: 怎么，雪松镇准备支持我们这群矮人的梦想，建一个机械研究所？

say:5:1321111004:1.text: Um... that's not the case. I'm only asking out of curiosity.
say:5:1321111004:1.source_cn: 啊……这倒不是，我只是随口问问。

say:6:1321111005:1.text: Tsk, I thought you guys finally had some sense. What a letdown.
say:6:1321111005:1.source_cn: 我还以为你们突然开窍了呢，真是白兴奋一场。

say:7:1321111006:1.text: Go away if you've got nothing else so I can focus on this machine. Without it, we could all be in trouble!
say:7:1321111006:1.source_cn: 没什么事就一边玩去吧，我还得研究这台机器。要是没了它，...

say:10:1321111007:1.text: No matter how I look at it, the most beautiful place in the Duchy of Whiteridge can't possibly be a research facility...
say:10:1321111007:1.source_cn: 呃……不管怎么想，白山公国的最美风景都不可能是机械研究...

say:13:1321111008:1.text: This answer isn't too helpful either. Let's approach others!
say:13:1321111008:1.source_cn: 看来这次获得的答案没什么帮助。我们再去问问其他人吧！
